never: invoke the upstream CLI or any upstream code
adapter_surface.status_reads: a local settings JSON file in a scratch directory; reports which documented settings keys are present and the state of the documented telemetry switches from the environment. Local only, no network, no credentials.

fallback: If Anthropic objects to the reference or a licence appears that requires it, the fork Amdkn/claude-code is deleted. The clean-room adapter is A'Space's own work and depends on no upstream file.

interface.description: Agentic coding tool that lives in the terminal, understands the codebase, and helps code faster through natural language commands (upstream README).

telemetry.data_collection_statement: Upstream README: 'When you use Claude Code, we collect feedback, which includes usage data (such as code acceptance or rejections), associated conversation data, and user feedback submitted via the /bug command.'
telemetry.ingest_note: Documented fact only. The A'Space adapter NEVER calls this endpoint or any other: it contains no network code at all.
